title: Team operations dashboard
summary: A dashboard app for team leads: KPIs, throughput, bottlenecks, cycle time, overdue work and announcements, with team, period and person filters and click-to-filter charts.
description:
Team operations dashboard is a ready-made app for team leads and operations managers. It opens from the Apps menu on an Overview of the work in your workspace: open and completed tasks, requests started, the average cycle time, throughput (created versus completed), on-time status, bottlenecks (where work waits, by workflow step) and cycle time, under an announcement you keep up to date.

Every page is driven by page filters: Team, Period and Person. On the Team page the charts filter each other: click a person in the open-tasks-per-person chart to filter the task list and the overdue list to them, or click a slice of the status chart to show only those tasks; Show everyone clears the person again.

The Delivery page reads two data tables the team leads keep: Work items (team, type, priority, status, cycle time) and Weekly delivery (planned and delivered per team per week), with delivered per team, per team and week, delivered against plan, work by type and cycle time by team. A Team work request form and workflow (triage, deliver, close with its cycle time) come with it, so the dashboard fills up with your own work as soon as people use it.
start: Open Team operations from the Apps menu; New request on the Team page starts the Team work item workflow.
setup: Open Apps → Team operations → Settings → Audience: add team leads as viewers (or contributors if they should send requests and claim tasks).
Create teams in Settings → Teams so the Team filter has something to choose; it narrows the task widgets to work routed to the chosen team.
Assignees: pick who triages new requests and who delivers them (change them to team queues later).
Replace the Work items and Weekly delivery sample rows with your own, and edit the announcement on the Overview.

steps.title: Overview
steps.body: KPIs, throughput, on-time status, bottlenecks and cycle time for the chosen team, period and person.

steps.title: Click to filter
steps.body: On the Team page, clicking a person or a status slice filters the task and overdue lists.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.body: Planned versus delivered per team and week, work by type and cycle time by team from two data tables.

steps.title: Requests
steps.body: New request sends a Team work request: the workflow logs it, the lead triages it and the team delivers it.

steps.title: Cycle time recorded
steps.body: Closing a work item records its cycle time in days in the Work items table.
